name: Mayou Uta
source:
A visual novel about how an air force member Marina encounters a singing merman Zeru while cruising the island and how this brings enormous changes to her boring life. Become the heroine Marina and see things through her eyes, listen through her ears and make choices through her heart. By facing herself, Marina will be able to witness the change of her and Zeru's future.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3548050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部视觉小说，讲述了空军成员玛丽娜在岛上巡航时如何遇到唱歌的人鱼泽鲁，以及这如何给她无聊的生活带来巨大变化的故事。成为女主角玛丽娜，用她的眼睛看事物，用她的耳朵听，用她的心做出选择。通过面对自己，玛丽娜将能够见证她和泽鲁未来的变化。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3548050/]Steam[/url]]
